All roads lead to @BarackObama  
#DNCHack #RussiaHoax #ObamaGate

First, let's lay out the TIMELINE of treason for clarity.

This isn't coincidence; it's coordination.

The so-called "hack" of the DNC servers kicks off in April 2016. Just around the time things heat up in the primaries. But wait, intrusions reportedly started as early as summer 2015. Cozy Bear and Fancy Bear? More like smoke and mirrors.

April 13, 2016: 
Barack Obama appoints Steven Chabinsky, CrowdStrike's General Counsel and Chief Risk Officer with DEEP FBI ties from his days as Deputy Assistant Director of their Cyber Division to the Commission on Enhancing National Cybersecurity. Scroll down this White House archive: https://obamawhitehouse.archives.gov/the-press-office/2016/04/13/president-obama-announces-more-key-administration-posts. 

Obama's handpicking a CrowdStrike insider for a key government role JUST as the DNC "breach" unfolds?  WHAT A COINCIDENCE.

Early May 2016:
DNC hires CrowdStrike through their lawyers at Perkins Coie. Not the FBI. Not independent forensics. 

A firm with Obama's freshly appointed exec on board. 

ANOTHER Coincidence!?

Perkins Coie didn't pick them by chance more like a directive from the top to control the narrative.

June 14, 2016:
DNC announces the breach publicly. That SAME DAY, CrowdStrike drops their report blaming "two Russian hacking groups." 

Russa, Russia, Russia narrative was seeded. Lest we forget, the FBI NEVER touched the servers. They rely on CrowdStrike's "assessment." 

Why? Because the DNC and Clinton's team at Perkins Coie are calling the shots.

July 10, 2016: 
Seth Rich, DNC staffer and Bernie supporter, gunned down in DC at 4:20 a.m. "Botched robbery," they say yet No valuables were taken. 

Weeks later, WikiLeaks drops the emails. Julian Assange hints at an insider leak, not a hack. #SethRich was murdered to silence the truth by MS-13 enforcers working on behalf of the uniparty.

The puppets of the elite don't like loose ends. So someone puts bullets into the men responsible for Seth's murder. Dead men tell no tales.

https://www.wmbfnews.com/story/32535510/police-ask-for-publics-help-in-solving-murder-of-2-men-found-in-socastee-parking-lot/

July 22, 2016: 
WikiLeaks unleashes the first batch of DNC emails at 10:30 a.m. EDT. Exposes the rigged primaries against Bernie. But the media spins it as "Russian interference." Cover story locked in.

Now, the WEB OF CONNECTIONS...

All tied to the same players who fueled the Russia hoax.

Another "Coincidence"

DNC shells out $9.1 MILLION to Perkins Coie.
Perkins Coie hires Fusion GPS for "opposition research."
Fusion GPS cooks up the phony Steele Dossier.

Debunked garbage that Durham later confirmed had ZERO corroborated intel.

Michael Sussmann, Perkins Coie partner, hires CrowdStrike for the DNC "hack" probe.

Read this archived National Review piece: 

"When Scandals Collide" 
https://www.nationalreview.com/corner/453092/scandals-collide-dossier-dnc-server-perkins-coie/. 

It lays out how the DNC/Clinton lawyers at Perkins Coie are the hub, linking the "hack" cover-up to the dossier smear.

Lets not forget: The Clinton campaign and DNC FUNDED the Steele Dossier research. 

Washington Post admitted it in Oct 2016: https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/national-security/clinton-campaign-dnc-paid-for-research-that-led-to-russia-dossier/2017/10/24/226fabf0-b8e4-11e7-a908-a3470754bbb9_story.html

They paid for lies to tie Trump to Russia, while hiding the real DNC leak.

The @FBI? Complicit. They showed ZERO interest in seizing the servers themselves. 

Instead, they took CrowdStrike's word. A contractor paid by the DNC/Clinton. 

Durham exposed how Crossfire Hurricane (illegal spying on Trump) was launched on this bogus intel. Obama briefed on "The Clinton Plan" to fabricate a Trump-Russia scandal. 

August 3, 2016

briefing with Biden, Brennan, Comey none of it was shared with agents or FISA courts.

Treason.

Chabinsky's FBI roots run deep: 1995-2012 in their Cyber Division. Obama appoints him mid-hack, Perkins Coie hires his firm, and two months later, "It was Russia!" Our tax dollars funneled through that commission paid for the Cover-up that started in the Oval Office.

This wasn't a hack—it was an INSIDE JOB to bury the leak, blame Russia, and weaponize it against Trump. Seth Rich paid with his life. The dossier? Funded fake news to launch the witch hunt.

Perkins Coie, Fusion GPS, CrowdStrike. All roads lead back to Obama guiding the strings.

@FBIDirectorKash @realDonaldTrump @PapiTrumpo  Can we arrest them now?
